response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT t.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), p AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY transreg, tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM p) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count_per_pair, AVG(share) AS avg_share_per_pair FROM s GROUP BY tradekind
